spec_evidence.checked: Cached snapshots, token-level: "iin" property token count 1 -> 0 spec-wide; the list of schemas carrying an iin property goes [card] -> [] (the v2324 payment-record card_details.iin removal already left that projection schema without the field). All 1603 response records of this pair are per-operation projections of the single legacy card schema change.

alternative_data_source: No successor on the card object: iin (first-six/BIN issuer metadata) is PCI-scoped data Stripe no longer exposes on the legacy card source schema. The brand, funding, last4 and exp_* leaves survive unchanged.

fix.migration_guide: subscription.latest_invoice.default_source.iin on POST /v1/quotes/{quote}/accept: the legacy card source schema lost its iin property in v2349 (token-verified 1 -> 0 spec-wide), so every response surface embedding a card object — including this one — stops returning the field. There is no successor; delete reads of .iin from card objects reached through this endpoint (charges' payment sources, customer default_source, external accounts and error.source projections alike). The surviving card identity leaves (brand, funding, last4, exp_month, exp_year) are unchanged.
